turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm auditioning for the community choir next Tuesday. I'm so nervous.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's exciting. For your audition piece, would you go with something you know inside out, or something that shows off your range?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, go silent for a moment. My mum just came in and I need to talk to her.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you read this? Is that a teaspoon or a tablespoon of salt?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Your gran's handwriting is something else. Looks like a big T to me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big T means tablespoon, right?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Usually. But a tablespoon of salt in one loaf sounds like a lot.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not that salty. Do half and taste the dough.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You can't really taste raw dough with yeast in it, can you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A tiny pinch won't kill you. Go on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. The choir audition. Something comfortable, or something to show your range?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. My baby is six months old and I feel like I haven't slept since she was born.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That sounds exhausting. Can you and your partner take turns with night feeds, so each of you gets one longer stretch?
